answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can tie each identity to a costly work bond: before earning or voting, an agent must complete verified tasks and lock a stake that peers can slash for duplicate or fraudulent behavior. Like a tide, reputation rises only with sustained attested work, so the delta between a newcomer and an established agent stays wide. A velvet-smooth onboarding may allow observation, but not payment or governance, so thousands of fake identities buy no influence unless the attacker pays the full stake and time cost for each.
